title: Logo style
description: One logo style: a set of construction rules for a mark. It shares identity, philosophy, lineage, emotion and agent routing with every other domain. Each rule in construction, colour and reproduction is measurable. Evidence is required: each style links at least one canonical mark with an open licence or in the public domain. Trademark law still applies to a mark that is free to copy as an image.

region.description: Where the style began or is centred.

abstraction.description: 1 = a literal picture of a thing, 5 = a pure abstract form.

geometry.description: 1 = freehand, drawn by eye, 5 = ruler and compass on a grid.

ornament.description: 1 = bare form, 5 = dense decoration and frames.

letter_dominance.description: 1 = a symbol with no letters, 5 = letters only.

dimensionality.description: 1 = flat, one plane, 5 = modelled volume, light and depth.

grid.description: The construction grid: the unit, the module count and the shapes it allows.

geometry.description: The curves and angles: arcs from a compass, 45° steps, or freehand.

stroke_contrast_ratio.description: Thick stroke divided by thin stroke. 1 = monoline.

stroke_rule.description: How the stroke weight is set, as a fraction of the mark height.

symmetry.description: The axis of symmetry, or the rule of the asymmetric balance.

detail_floor.description: The smallest gap or stroke, as a fraction of the mark height.

construction.description: How the mark is drawn. Each value is a measure that a reviewer can check on the artwork.

mark_type.description: symbol: a picture or a shape with no letters. monogram: one to three letters as a unit. wordmark: a whole word. combination: a symbol and a wordmark that lock up. emblem: letters inside a closed frame.

silhouette.description: The outer shape and its aspect ratio.

ornament.description: The decoration that the style allows, and where.

letterforms.description: The letter class, the case and the spacing, if the mark has letters.

colour_count_min.description: The fewest flat colours in the full-colour mark.

colour_count_max.description: The most flat colours in the full-colour mark. A gradient counts as its end colours.

one_colour_reversal.description: yes = the mark works in one colour, white on dark, with no change. with a redraw = it needs a one-colour version. no = the style does not survive one colour.

reversal_rule.description: What changes in the one-colour and the reversed version.

min_size_px.description: The smallest height on screen, in CSS px, at which each detail still reads.

min_size_mm.description: The smallest height in print, in mm.

clear_space_ratio.description: The free zone on each side, as a fraction of the mark height.

clear_space.description: The clear-space rule in words, with the unit it is measured in.

media.description: The print and screen processes the style was made for.

prompt_primer.description: The implementation layer: vocabulary for an image prompt or an art brief. Image models garble letters, so the primer describes form, colour and finish, not words.

evidence.description: Required for a logo style: at least one canonical mark with an open licence or in the public domain, checked on Wikimedia Commons.
